_comment: A prompt whose greedy reply on Qwen3-30B-A3B Q8_0 is the same 55 tokens on an MI50 under RADV in the Q8_0 decode kernel's quarter layout and in its half-block order, and then parts: the quarter layout takes the first of the two tokens, the half-block order the second. tools/decode_probe.cpp reads the prompt as one prefill and each id as a decode step, as a request alone runs through the server; each order puts its own token ahead there by the logits recorded below, and the two runs route to other experts at a router near-tie from the prompt's last row on (docs/STATUS-2026-09.md, The half-block order).
